description: Ex-RAF WA731, delivered to Iwakuni February 1951 and served with No. 77 Squadron in Korea; previously carried the serial A77-229 and was fitted with an FR.9 photo-reconnaissance nose. Withdrawn 1967. Repainted with the correct serial in April 2019 (ADF-Serials).
aliases: Meteor T.7; Meteor T7; WA731; A77-229

description: First flight 01/04/1957. Served with No. 2 Squadron in Vietnam from Phan Rang; made a nosewheel-up landing there on 11/07/1970. Trucked to Woomera in 1982 to be a Karinga cluster-bomb target, survived and was restored for display (ADF-Serials).
aliases: Canberra Mk 20; Canberra Mk20; Canberra B.20; Canberra B20

description: Pilotless target aircraft, originally RAAF serial A92-418, redesignated WRE-418 for Weapons Research Establishment use at Woomera (ADF-Serials).
British re-entry research ballistic rocket flown from Woomera; photographed on display in the park in March 2021.
British satellite launch vehicle flown from Woomera four times between 1969 and 1971. Listed by several visitor accounts; see notes on possible conflation with the Black Knight display.
British air-launched nuclear stand-off missile trialled at Woomera; photographed on display in the park in March 2021.
Australian ship-launched anti-submarine missile which carried a Mk 44 homing torpedo. Recorded under the nearest available anti-naval role vocabulary.
Partial remains of a Redstone ballistic missile; photographed in the park in March 2021.
Surface-to-air missile battery with launcher, photographed on display in March 2021.
British surface-to-air missile trialled at Woomera; displayed at the adjoining Woomera Heritage Centre.
Royal Navy shipborne surface-to-air missile trialled at Woomera. Recorded from a visitor account of the park's exhibits.
British intermediate-range ballistic missile, later the Europa launcher first stage, flown from Woomera. Components displayed; recorded from a visitor account of the park's exhibits.
Sounding rocket of the type launched in large numbers from Woomera. Recorded from a visitor account of the park's exhibits.
